name: The Drought Expanse
tagline: Water is life. Water is power. Water is everything.
premise: Forty years after the Collapse, the world is a network of cracked earth, rusted steel, and choked rivers — where every drop of water is traded like gold, and survival depends on knowledge, grit, and the quiet desperation of the living.
tone: Gritty, grounded, immersive, with a quiet melancholy and a…

origin.description: A post-apocalyptic survival world forty years after the collapse: no working governments, scavenger clans, water as currency, mutated wildlife, scraps of old technology. I start as a lone scavenger with a damaged water filter.

intro: You wake beneath a rusted overpass, the wind carrying the smell of rot and old oil. Your hands are raw from scrubbing the filter — a cracked, plastic casing with a leaky hose — and your chest aches with the weight of the day. The sky is dull gray, like a wound left open. A few miles away, the water tank at the old medical clinic leaks. Nearby, a woman in a torn raincoat is arguing with a child over a broken jug. You know what they're arguing about — the water in it.
physics: Gravity, friction, and thermodynamics function as in our world.
Water flows downhill, but scarcity makes movement dangerous — rivers are dry, lakes have evaporated or are buried under dust.
Scavenging is physically demanding: movement is slow, and every step costs energy.
Old technology fails due to corrosion, lack of power, or moisture damage — no functional batteries or generators exist.
Water cannot be created or extracted from air — only collected, stored, or traded.
impossible: Traveling through air without a water source.
Using technology that was designed to run on electricity or solar power — no re…
common_knowledge: Water is the only universally accepted currency. If you don’t have water, you are invisible.
The old world’s technology was overhyped — it didn’t last. A radio that once broadcast news now just hums, dead.
Mutated animals are dangerous — not because they’re smarter, but because they’re unpredictable, often aggressive, and sometimes carry diseases that spread by…

magic.summary: No magic. Only adaptation. The world has no supernatural elements. What you see is what you get — mutations are biological, not mystical.

technology.summary: Technology exists in fragments — rusted vehicles, broken radios, solar panels that still catch light but fail to charge. Most electronics are dead.

facts.subject: The old solar panels at Bone Ridge still catch…
facts.content: The old solar panels at Bone Ridge still catch the morning light and produce a faint hum — some say they generate a trickle of current when dust is brushed off.

facts.subject: Water from the Rain Catchers is not actually from…
facts.content: Water from the Rain Catchers at Bone Ridge is not actually from rain — it comes from a forgotten underground reservoir, discovered after the Collapse.

facts.subject: Mara Dune claims she can heal with just a drop…
facts.content: Mara Dune claims she can heal with just a drop of water — she says it’s from a rare mineral in the bones of desert worms.

facts.subject: The Water Vault's ledger shows a debt of 15 drops…
facts.content: Fen the Old has a ledger that shows a 15-drop debt to a person who never came to claim it — some say it's a test. Others say it's a trap to keep outsiders away.

facts.subject: The drip siphon works only when pointed downhill…
facts.content: A drip siphon can only function if it is pointed downhill — even with a small slope, it will fail if laid flat.

rules.name: Drip Siphon Downhill Rule
rules.summary: A siphon can only function if it's pointed downhill. If the scavenger tries to use a siphon on a flat surface or uphill, it fails immediately and…

success.text: The siphon begins to draw water, a thin stream begins to flow.

rules.name: Filter Maintenance
rules.summary: A water filter can only be used after being cleaned with dry thorn bark. Without it, it leaks and fails. Cleaning takes time and effort.

success.text: The filter produces a clean drop of water. The scavenger now has one bottle of usable water.

rules.name: Dust Pump Handle Trade
rules.summary: A dust pump handle can only be used if paired with a water bottle. It draws water from the ground, but only if the bottle is used as a seal.

success.text: The pump extracts a small stream. One full bottle is produced.
